title: Third Declension Adjectives
subtitle: fortis, ingens, vetus. Three patterns.
objectives: Apply agreement rules to third-declension adjectives.

sections.heading: Third-declension adjectives
sections.body:
Two-termination (m./f. and n.): fortis, forte (brave)
  Sg: fortis, fortis, fortī, fortem, fortī (m./f.); forte, fortis, fortī, forte, fortī (n.)

One-termination (all genders): ingēns, ingentis (huge)

Caesar writes: vir fortis. — A brave man.
Cicero writes: rēs ingēns. — A huge affair.

words.gloss: A brave man rules the kingdom.
